summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release reporting new residential construction statistics for August 2022, issued September 20, 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 3b provides "New Privately-Owned Housing Units Started" on a not seasonally adjusted basis, including monthly totals for the Northeast and Midwest regions.
